meta.source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Ag Decision Maker
meta.product: A1-20 Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa – 2026
meta.citation: Chad Hart. Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa – 2026. Ag Decision Maker File A1-20 (FM 1712, revised January 2026). Iowa State University Extension and Outreach. https://www.extension.iastate.edu/agdm/crops/html/a1-20.html
meta.method: Each budget is the Example sheet of ISU's A1-20 Excel tool (the publication's values at its middle yield level); total cost per acre checked against the PDF text.
meta.operating_definition: ISU 'variable' costs: seed, fertilizer and lime, pesticides, crop insurance, miscellaneous, interest on pre-harvest variable costs, and machinery fuel, oil and repairs (incl. drying, hauling and handling per bushel)
meta.fixed_definition: ISU 'fixed' costs: machinery depreciation, interest, insurance and housing; operator labour; land (cash rent equivalent)
